prompt_generated: Create a professional modern infographic titled 'Apicultura Urbana' with subtitle 'Produce tu Propia Miel de Forma Sostenible'. The infographic should have a vertical layout with 7 main sections. Section 1: header section with title and subtitle. Section 2: statistics section with 4 key metrics showing duration (6 weeks), sessions (12), hours per session (2), and credits (3). Section 3: text section describing target audience as young adults and parents interested in home self-sufficiency. Section 4: list section with 4 objectives including safe beekeeping initiation, pollinator conservation, family honey production, and additional income generation. Section 5: timeline section with 4 modules covering fundamentals, installation and management, sustainable production, and commercialization over 6 weeks. Section 6: text section describing the 3-hour pilot workshop. Section 7: footer with course route information. Use a modern design style with primary color #10B981 (nature green) and secondary color #059669. The background should be #FFFFFF with #1F2937 text. Include professional typography using Inter font family. Make it visually appealing, modern, and suitable for educational content. Ensure all text is readable and the layout is clean and organized. High quality, professional design, suitable for print and digital use. Clean typography, proper spacing, and visual hierarchy. Include bee and honey-related visual elements. Modern, engaging, and educational design.

usage_instructions.description: Cómo usar este JSON para generar la infografía del curso de apicultura urbana
steps: 1. Copia el contenido del campo 'data' del JSON
2. Ve a la página de infografías (/infographics)
3. Selecciona 'Crear Nueva' o usa un template educativo
4. Pega el JSON en el editor o configura manualmente
5. Personaliza colores si es necesario (verde para naturaleza)
6. Genera la infografía con DALL-E 3 o Stability AI
7. Descarga y usa para promoción del curso
customization_tips: Los colores verdes (#10B981, #059669) representan naturaleza y sostenibilidad
Los iconos de abejas (🐝) y miel (🍯) refuerzan el tema apícola
El timeline vertical muestra la progresión del curso claramente
Las estadísticas destacan la duración y estructura del curso
El watermark incluye la ruta de autosuficiencia del hogar
